aiDescription: Provides custom paintjobs for the Diable Avionics faction, accessible via the refit screen. Includes new skins for Virtuous and Gust ships, along with unused sprites for missiles, hullmods, stations, and campaign props. Uses the Magic Lib paintjob framework.
